lines.t: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
Therefore all else is vanity, a false way, leading to great vexation of spirit.
For I am the Lord from the beginning, it was I who had done it.
Even to the end shall I perform it.
And behold, all is fulfilled according to my will.
Therefore to fear the Lord your God is indeed the beginning of wisdom.
For how can one know me
And how can one fear me
He who caused us to be,
he who called all things into existence,
the creator of heaven and earth.
